game.label: Your disc image (.iso) of Valkyria Chronicles III for PSP: the Japanese v1.01 release (ULJM-05781) with the English fan-translation patch applied. Unpatched Japanese discs are not supported yet.

prepare.label: Recompiling the game from your disc (needs the free Microsoft C++ Build Tools)

exit_codes.20: That disc image isn't a supported copy: it needs Valkyria Chronicles III (Japan v1.01, ULJM-05781) with the English fan-translation patch applied. Pick your copy on the game's page.
exit_codes.21: The game is compiled on your PC with Microsoft's free C++ Build Tools, and they weren't found. Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with "Desktop development with C++", then run the setup again.
exit_codes.22: The game hasn't been built from your disc yet. Run the setup again on the game's page.
exit_codes.23: The game has to be rebuilt after the update, and the rebuild was stopped. Press Play again and let it finish.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Borderless fills your screen and lets you switch apps quickly. Fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself. F11 switches while playing.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size of the window when it isn't fullscreen.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 1x is the PSP's own 480x272; 3D scenes get sharper as it goes up.

settings.label: Picture shape
settings.help: Keep shows the PSP's 16:9 picture with bars where needed. Pixel perfect uses whole-number scaling.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: Battles and maps run at 30 FPS on the PSP. 60 FPS draws them twice as often at the same game speed. Experimental.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for your screen's refresh so the picture never tears.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The game's frame rate and the display's refresh in the corner.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Smooth blends texture pixels; Sharp keeps them blocky like an emulator's nearest setting.

settings.label: Anisotropic filtering
settings.help: Keeps ground textures sharp at shallow angles. Costs next to nothing.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing (MSAA)
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges in 3D scenes. Higher costs more graphics power.

settings.label: FXAA
settings.help: A light edge smoothing over the whole picture, menus included.

settings.label: Texture upscaling
settings.help: Smooths the game's low-resolution textures and art as they load.

settings.label: Confirm button
settings.help: Which controller button confirms in menus. A (bottom) is the PSP's USA layout.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The game's log (vc3recomp.log) and settings file.
